triac.interpretation: If the IF envelope never exceeds the IF reference level no discontinuous disturbance is registered. If it does, the events of one firing burst are 10 ms apart (< 200 ms) -> 'disturbances other than clicks' (3.3.3, Figure 3) -> Table 5 limits apply without relaxation (4.4.2.2, PDF p. 39), which is test A1.

A0_zcd_timing_E1.F1_effect: F1 takes the zero as the centre of the measured window; E1 delays the start edge by 6-11 us and the end edge by a similar RC/phototransistor-limited amount, so the centre estimate moves by <= 11 us: |v| at the zero estimate <= 325 V * 2 pi 50 * 11 us = 1.1 V, far below the 8.7-17.7 V gate threshold -> F1 unchanged

A1_crosscheck_scopeB.doc:
Cross-check of scope-B hardware proposals against test A1 (EN 55014-1 Table 5 conducted emission).

P-D1 : Y1 capacitor SELV GND -> NEUT next to PS1 (470 pF / 1 nF / 2.2 nF, 5 nH ESL assumed), node gndb -> l1_1 (L1.1 on NEUT)
P-S2b: second TVR14431 (370 pF, TVR10391KSY.pdf p. 7) LINE_FUSED -> NEUT in front of L40 (node l40_2 -> c40_2, 15 nH assumed)
P-E1 : 1 nF on the ZCD collector node -> zcd_timing.py with +8.4 us edge delay (section A0_zcd_timing_E1)
Model change for this cross-check: oven chassis <-> SELV ground coupling C_cs (thermocouple probe/lead inside the oven),
assumed 20 pF nominal, MC 5-100 pF, plus a 'probe bonded to chassis' case (10 nF). The baseline is re-run with it.
CMC L1 core loss: 15 kohm parallel per winding (5-50 k in the MC); a lossless 10 mH CMC resonates with the
HLK primary-secondary capacitance near 265 kHz and gives a spurious, very sharp N-line peak (first run, not kept).
Monte Carlo: 120 paired draws (identical random parameters for every variant), with V_on 10-40 V (as designed) and
8-18 V (F1 firmware), 4 variants each, run in parallel processes.
Writes results.json sections 'A1_crosscheck_scopeB' and 'A1_F1_construction_grid'.

selv_noise_bound.note: ideal Thevenin EMF between SELV GND (gndb) and the reference plane, i.e. the open-circuit ground-noise voltage scope C reports; narrowband noise is limited by the AV column (QP = AV for a steady sine). Impulsive noise would be read lower by AV. Harmonic lines of the 580 kHz buck and 1.2 MHz boost: compare each line.

A1_F1_construction_grid.note: worst of lines L/N; V_on 18 V = upper end of the F1 gate-threshold range (8.7-17.7 V); C_cs 20 pF, no scope-B parts
